applies_to.quote: All Primary Dealers, Standing Liquidity Facility for Primary Dealers

answer.action: Primary dealers must note the increased repo rate of 5.50 percent applicable to the Standing Liquidity Facility.
answer.action_quote: Accordingly, the Standing Liquidity Facility provided to Primary Dealers (PDs) (collateralised liquidity support) from the Reserve Bank would be available at the revised repo rate of 5.50 per cent with immediate effect.
